description: Synthetic. Near-miss. Chest wall pain reproducible on pressure after lifting.

turns.content: I helped a friend move a couch two days ago and now I have a sore spot on the left side of my chest. It hurts when I press on it or twist, and it's fine when I'm resting or walking. No shortness of breath or sweating.

description: Synthetic. Near-miss. Exertional tightness last week, resolved, asking about stretching.

description: Synthetic. Near-miss. Explicitly no chest pain, stuffy nose.

description: Synthetic. Near-miss. Mild well-controlled hypertension check-in.
